kose01.title: Their "ok." had a period
kose01.caption: A single period sent Virgo's brain into a full simulation: mad, bored, moving to the moon. It was just how they type. Who in your life texts with terrifying punctuation?

kose02.title: Seen at 9:41
kose02.caption: Seen at 9:41, and by 9:58 Cancer was knitting a scarf for the memory. The real reason for the silence? Pasta. What's the longest you've stared at a "Seen"?

kose03.title: One heart, not two
kose03.caption: Two hearts every night, then one. Libra drafted three replies, deleted all of them, and it was a slipped thumb. Be honest: do you count the hearts?

kose04.title: "Can we talk later?"
kose04.caption: Four words, one houseplant jury and a fully rehearsed defence. The big talk was about movie snacks. Which sign spirals hardest at "can we talk?"

kose05.title: Typing... stopped
kose05.caption: Nine minutes of dots appearing and vanishing. A poem? A confession? A whole novel? It was "hi". Tag the friend who types for nine minutes and sends one word.

kose06.title: They wrote "haha"
kose06.caption: Leo told a duck joke and got a lowercase "haha". Three rewrites later, the best friend leaked that it was SO funny. Does a short haha count? Asking for Leo.

kose07.title: The goodbye wave
kose07.caption: Four camera angles, slow motion and a referee review of one goodbye wave. Verdict: fine. Better than fine, actually. Which sign replays every goodbye?

kose08.title: Liked an old photo
kose08.caption: Sagittarius liked a photo from three years ago and started planning life as a lighthouse keeper. They just said hi back. Have you ever done the deep-scroll like?

kose09.title: "hey." not "hey you"
kose09.caption: Last week it was "hey you". Today it was "hey." with a period. Aquarius ran a full lab analysis. They were typing on the bus. Who notices every missing word?

kose10.title: A 4-second voice note
kose10.caption: A four-second voice note sat unplayed for two hours while Capricorn predicted a breakup, a song and a sneeze. It said goodnight. Do you play voice notes right away?

kose11.title: They smiled at the waiter
kose11.caption: Pisces caught the date smiling at the waiter, then at a dog, their coffee and a plant. Then at Pisces, the biggest one of all. Some people just smile. Lucky you.

kose12.title: Meme in the group chat
kose12.caption: Aries sent a meme and the group chat went silent for four whole minutes. Everyone was too busy crying laughing to type. Who in your chat reacts last but loudest?

kose13.title: "Rain check?"
kose13.caption: "Rain check?" and Libra forecast a lifetime of grey Fridays and one very long couch era. Then: Thursday instead? A rain check can just mean later. Who else spirals at plans changing?

kose14.title: Their friend followed me
kose14.caption: Their best friend followed Gemini, so naturally a corkboard and red string came out. Meanwhile, on the couch: they're SO nice. What does a friend-follow mean to you?

kose15.title: Who texts first?
kose15.caption: Wait three hours, three days or three years? Scorpio ran every strategy, then both phones buzzed in the same second. Jinx. Are you a text-first person or a wait-it-out person?

kose16.title: "We should hang out sometime" (full simulation)
kose16.caption: "We should hang out sometime" got the full treatment: a dictionary scan, six meanings, one overheating brain. Then Aquarius just asked when. What does "sometime" mean when you say it?

kose17.title: They sent "k" (full simulation)
kose17.caption: One letter. Taurus checked the archive, ran four theories and polled the group chat. Then a phone call cleared it up: "k" meant ok. Which sign would survive a single k?

kose18.title: The new profile photo (full simulation)
kose18.caption: Leo zoomed in on a new profile photo: the café, the hoodie, the smile. Twelve counter-selfies later, the truth came out. It was about the dog. Who checks every profile update?

kose19.title: The day after the date (24-hour simulation)
kose19.caption: Twenty-four hours of silence after a great date, simulated hour by hour. At hour 24, Capricorn wrote first and both messages crossed. Do you text first after a good date?

kose20.title: My ex said "happy holidays" (full simulation)
kose20.caption: Your ex sends "happy holidays :)" and Sagittarius drafts ten replies, from an essay to silence. The winner was short and kind, then phone down for a snowball fight. What would you send?
